nodes.label: Fixed-timestep accumulator loop
nodes.rationale: Simulation always advances in exact TICK_DT steps regardless of display refresh rate, which keeps runs deterministic; frame time is clamped (MAX_FRAME_TIME) to survive tab-switch pauses.

nodes.label: Seeded deterministic randomness
nodes.rationale: All gameplay randomness must flow through the seeded mulberry32 PRNG, never Math.random(), so a run is reproducible from its seed - required later for daily challenges and shareable replays.

nodes.label: One-thumb drag placement UX
nodes.rationale: Drag starts on the build button in the bottom dock; on touch the ghost is offset ~1.6 cells above the finger so the finger never hides the target cell; releasing off the board cancels. Designed for one-thumb mobile play.

nodes.label: First-enemy targeting policy
nodes.rationale: Towers target the in-range enemy furthest along the path ('first'), using path distance (enemy.dist) rather than proximity to the tower.
